headline: Linc Limited submits postal ballot proceedings and voting results
hook: Postal ballot results finalized by Linc
summary: Linc Limited has submitted the results of its recent postal ballot along with the scrutinizer's report to the stock exchanges. This routine corporate filing completes the shareholder voting process on resolutions put forward by the company. Shareholders and investors can review the voting outcomes for corporate governance insights. The update has no direct financial impact on the company's near-term earnings.
why_it_matters: Routine filing with no direct impact on retail investors
